name: Corporate Action SD 27
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

NoticeType.name: Notice Type
NoticeType.definition: Indicates whether the notice received was universal or specific to securities registered in DTC's nominee name.

EventCashValue.name: Event Cash Value
EventCashValue.definition: Amount of cash set aside by the offeror. This is the maximum amount that the offeror is willing to pay out to the holders who elect to take part in the offer.

NumberOfSharesToBeIssued.name: Number Of Shares To Be Issued
NumberOfSharesToBeIssued.definition: Number of shares the issuer is creating as part of the event.

TotalNumberOfSharesOffered.name: Total Number Of Shares Offered
TotalNumberOfSharesOffered.definition: Total number of shares that are part of the offer, for example, subscription offer.

CutOffDays.name: Cut Off Days
CutOffDays.definition: Number of additional days used to establish a DTC processing cut-off date. For example, DTC typically adds a cut-off off day (making it one business day prior) to the record date for issues with agents outside NYC. This allows time for DTC to deliver the securities.

DTCAutomatedOfferProgram.name: DTC Automated Offer Program
DTCAutomatedOfferProgram.definition: Indicator that identifies the type of interface an event agent has with DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation). This defines how time sensitive the instruction and withdrawal process is. An offline (non automated) agent will have earlier deadlines which will be reflected in response deadlines but importantly withdrawal procedures for a manual agent requires hard copy sign off from the agent that has to be delivered to DTC to proceed with withdrawal.

DTCRecycleCutOffIndicator.name: DTC Recycle Cut Off Indicator
DTCRecycleCutOffIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the recycling of instructions for eligible positions is set to end early or late at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

LongShortPaymentIndicator.name: Long Short Payment Indicator
LongShortPaymentIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the first accrual period for debt instruments is either long or short, compared to the normal accrual period of the security.

OversubscriptionType.name: Oversubscription Type
OversubscriptionType.definition: Type of oversubscription on the event.

ConditionalPaymentApplicableFlag.name: Conditional Payment Applicable Flag
ConditionalPaymentApplicableFlag.definition: Indicates whether the payment made by the issuer is based on a stated condition.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

SolicitationDealerFeeFlag.name: Solicitation Dealer Fee Flag
SolicitationDealerFeeFlag.definition: Indicates whether there is a solicitation fee on the event. This fee is paid by the soliciting dealer.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DTCCustodyEligibleFlag.name: DTC Custody Eligible Flag
DTCCustodyEligibleFlag.definition: Indicates whether positions held in custody program are eligible for instruction processing at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DTCReorganisationCustodyEligibleFlag.name: DTC Reorganisation Custody Eligible Flag
DTCReorganisationCustodyEligibleFlag.definition: Indicates whether the event is eligible for the custody reorganisation service at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation). |Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DTCReorganisationDepositEligibleFlag.name: DTC Reorganisation Deposit Eligible Flag
DTCReorganisationDepositEligibleFlag.definition: Indicates whether the event is eligible for the reorganisation deposit service at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

SurrenderSharesToAgentFlag.name: Surrender Shares To Agent Flag
SurrenderSharesToAgentFlag.definition: Indicates whether shares outside of DTC need to be delivered to the agent in order to receive entitlement.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

StepUpPrivilegeFlag.name: Step Up Privilege Flag
StepUpPrivilegeFlag.definition: Indicates that the holder has the privilege to buy additional rights. Upon exercising this privilege, the holder may subscribe to one additional share of the new security in lieu of fractional shares to which the holder might otherwise be entitled.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

RightsOversubscriptionFlag.name: Rights Oversubscription Flag
RightsOversubscriptionFlag.definition: Indicates whether holders of rights will be afforded the opportunity to subscribe to purchase extra shares that are not picked up by the remaining holders.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

RightsRoundUpPrivilegeFlag.name: Rights Round Up Privilege Flag
RightsRoundUpPrivilegeFlag.definition: Indicates whether the shareholder will be able to round up its subscription in the event its rights are less than the requirement.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

RightsTransferableFlag.name: Rights Transferable Flag
RightsTransferableFlag.definition: Indicates whether rights can be transferred.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DissenterRightsApplicableFlag.name: Dissenter Rights Applicable Flag
DissenterRightsApplicableFlag.definition: Indicates whether rights are available to stockholders as a remedy when they object to the terms of proposed corporate actions. For example, actions can include but are not limited to a merger or a sale of assets. |This flag will output to Y/N ("true"/"false" or "1"/"0") or whereas the Option Features Code (DISS) in the standard only used when Yes. |Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

NonExemptAllowedIndicator.name: Non Exempt Allowed Indicator
NonExemptAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the certificate of deposit early redemption event is exempt from the presentation of the required legal documentation. When presentation is exempt, the instructing client agrees to maintain such documentation for at least 30 months following payment of the request.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DTCInstructionLockoutIndicator.name: DTC Instruction Lockout Indicator
DTCInstructionLockoutIndicator.definition: Indicates whether instructions are temporarily blocked for the event.

CertificateDetails.name: Certificate Details
CertificateDetails.definition: Details of certificates that have been called for redemption.

EDSMessagingCountryCode.name: EDS Messaging Country Code
EDSMessagingCountryCode.definition: Country of issue used to determine whether the electable option requires tax exempt or wire information when sending EDS elections via the CAIN message type.

RDPReferenceNumber.name: RDP Reference Number
RDPReferenceNumber.definition: Unique DTCC legacy reference used for matching and reconciling legacy CCF records. The element will be populated to all levels of the message (event details, options, movements) where applicable to indicate how values are sourced from CCF legacy files. For example: event has 2 related activity types 74, and 54. If event details and cash option are sourced from the activity type 74, then activity type 74 will be in RDP reference number in event details, and also on the cash option. The activity type 54 will be "on" the security option. Also, usage rules will specify the different layouts of the RDP reference number based on DTCC event group (reorganization, distribution, or redemption).

DTCForeignTaxElectionFlag.name: DTC Foreign Tax Election Flag
DTCForeignTaxElectionFlag.definition: Identifies events that offer instruction processing specific to foreign tax elections.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DTCTotalCalledQuantity.name: DTC Total Called Quantity
DTCTotalCalledQuantity.definition: Total Called Quantity for secuirty held at DTC including FAST and Registered positions.

EDSMessagingCountryCodeGuideline.definition: The value of the element "EDSMessagingCountryCode" impacts the presence of certain details that clients need to submit as part of their CAIN instruction when combined with the following rules: |a. If "EDSMessagingCountryCode" value is “CA” (Canada), and the option type equals FCPX (Foreign Currency Payment Exempt), FORX (Foreign Tax Relief Exempt), or DRPX (DRIP Exempt), then the Tax Exempt component must be populated in the corporate action Instruction (CAIN) supplementary data; |b. All Foreign Currency Payments (FCP) require wire information when submitting elections via ISO 20022 messaging, with one exception: If "EDSMessagingCountryCode" value is “CA” (Canada) and the extensions option action type is FCPU, FCPF, FCPX, then no wire instructions are required.
